The workbook Amadeus data sources!I13 says Earthdata login required; that does not describe access to these tested public URLs. The schema slot description also generalizes GEOS authentication; the boolean here describes the selected provider route. Inventory H13 Active is source status, J13 2018 is history, N13 global is coverage context; none establishes per-file availability or validity. Cite Keller et al. (2021), methods DOI 10.1029/2020MS002413, not a collection DOI. See geos_review_20261109/README.md for evidence and outstanding datum/ETH/TH questions. No verified archive end date is asserted. Expanded 2026-11-20 to all 16 workbook GEOS-CF profiles, with 466 bindings. The original six profiles and 168 native-reviewed bindings are preserved. The ten additions are specification-backed; fresh NASA/NTRS v1.3 PDFs match retained evidence. Public assimilation DDS/DAS metadata are separate from native-file verification. New access/decoding, service-name and geodetic gaps remain explicit in dataset_spec_objects/geos_collection_extension_20261120/README.md; no additional R execution route is certified.

data_sources.name: epa_tri_basic
data_sources.label: EPA TRI Basic data
data_sources.producer_institution: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
data_sources.description: Annual facility-reported chemical release/transfer inventory under TRI reporting scope and thresholds. Release mass is not environmental concentration, exposure or toxicity-weighted risk. Dioxin-category mass is grams; other chemicals are pounds. Grams-TEQ is a separate quantity requiring congener/TEF information. Historical submissions may be revised; pin retrieved file checksums. EPA public data; credit EPA TRI and reporting year.

products.name: cdl_usda_conus_30m_2008_2023
products.label: USDA CDL annual CONUS 30 m, 2008–2023
products.description: Annual national CONUS native 30 m USDA CDL class maps for map years 2008–2023 only. This profile excludes pre-2008 partial-state deliveries, Hawaii, native 10 m maps from 2024 onward, later 30 m resampled products, and separate confidence/cultivated/frequency layers. Use the matching YYYY_30m_cdls.zip national link for 2008–2023 on Product.access_url; retain the actual resolved file URL, map year and available revision/edition metadata. Annual editions are distinguished by map year; no common series-wide release/revision identifier is verified, so product_version is not fabricated. The historical direct 2023 URL used by the legacy downloader returned 404 during this review; the provider index links to /sites/default/files/Research_and_Science/Cropland/Release/datasets/. The new 2019 and 2023 links were inspected with HTTP byte ranges, not full science-array downloads. The original national world files for those two years verify 30 m pixels and matching pixel-centre origins; 2023 archive metadata supplies dimensions for that delivery only. Their TIFF directories lie outside the inspected prefixes, and all-year geometry invariance is unverified. The shared GridDefinition therefore retains verified NAD83 Albers EPSG:5070 and 30 m resolution only; common dimensions/origins remain unset. Read the acquired native header before any ROI windowing. Do not promote a state/processed subset or one annual header to the whole series. If a requested delivery genuinely has different CRS/resolution/geometry requirements, first verify it and link an appropriate existing or distinct grid/product rather than overwrite this shared definition. Map labels are nominal crop/non-crop classes, not yields, percentages or QA-confidence values. Map year describes harvest/growing-season classification, not a uniform daily observation interval. Keep native EPSG:5070 distinct from Annual NLCD WGS84 Albers. See cropscape_review_20261110/README.md for original archive metadata, world files, legend scopes and verification limits. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Amadeus data sources!N7 describes CONUS coverage from 2008 and earlier partial states; it does not establish per-pixel validity or fill observation gaps.

products.name: edgar_v81_bc_annual_totals_emi
products.label: EDGAR v8.1 BC annual TOTALS emi
products.description: All-sector annual totals delivery, 1970–2022. The 2022 original file for this exact species/output was inspected. Emissions are tonnes per cell for the named year; fluxes are kg/m2/s. These are distinct products and cannot use the same polygon reduction. calculate_edgar currently hardcodes a mean: that is not a polygon total for cell mass. A total needs clipped cell-mass allocation; a flux integral needs cell areas and verified time support, not an assumed 365-day multiplier. No monthly/sector-specific scale is copied from this profile. Global coordinate centres are verified, but the file has no explicit datum authority: GDAL CRS84 is an interpretation, not provider datum evidence. AMADEUS:100007 is an unresolved required-slot placeholder; no geometry execution is certified. The existing unit_conversion_formula declares the native-to-canonical conversion; process_edgar does not execute that catalog formula. Its current output remains in reader-decoded native units. Do not label an unconverted native-unit spatial mean as a canonical-unit polygon total.

products.name: gmted2010_be15_arcgrid
products.label: GMTED2010 Breakline Emphasis 15 arcsec
products.description: Original provider Arc/Info binary grid (AIG), not ASCII Grid. Native archive metadata for this exact variant verifies dimensions, geotransform, WGS84 and Int16 nodata -32768. AIG has no existing accurate format enum; native_format is intentionally unset. No scale or offset supplied: valid signed elevations are metres, negative elevations and zero are valid. GMTED standard deviation measures sub-cell elevation variation, not DEM accuracy or absolute elevation. Native GeoTIFF sample metadata independently corroborates every statistic/resolution; TIFF tile extent is not the full ArcGrid extent. Angular grids retain a half-arcsecond offset; do not snap to -180/90. Thirty-arcsecond mean/subsample grids have 20880 rows, others 16800; finer archives have 33600/67200 rows. Not all statistic/resolution combinations share polar coverage. Floating writer differences below 0.001 cell across the domain share one GridDefinition; each exact native geotransform is retained in arcgrid_native.json. No synthetic time interval is assigned. The USGS FGDC record describes source-elevation provenance and aggregate accuracy; it does not by itself certify every native compressed block or a uniform vertical reference for every contributing source. Those per-delivery checks remain open. Reference: https://topotools.cr.usgs.gov/gmted_viewer/gmted2010_fgdc_metadata.html.

products.spatial_extent_descriptor: CONUS/PACUS sector; satellite-specific fixed-grid window
products.description: Provider registry C01510 and retained native_headers.json establish identity and sample layout. Algorithm transition on 2024-04-17 is day-level; inspect each granule to disambiguate the transition day. GOES-16 Baseline starts at the first object date observed in the S3 prefix, not the NCEI programme start or proof of continuous coverage. GOES-18 Baseline is limited to the operational GOES-West epoch starting 2023-01-04 at 18:00 UTC. Earlier GOES-18 test/drift files beginning in 2022 use different orbital positions and are excluded from this 137-degree-West grid profile. NOAA operational/drift notices are retained in the evidence directory; date-only coverage cannot encode the within-day transition. Cadence depends on mode/epoch/sector: no uniform five-minute interval is asserted. Use file time bounds. Smoke/Dust are column detection flags, not AOD, PM2.5, surface exposure or verified absence under clouds/night/snow. Apply algorithm-specific DQF, solar/view-angle and glint screens from the NOAA guide. Current process_goes does not apply those screens; it may interpolate flags during reprojection and permits arithmetic daily aggregation. These routes identify existing interfaces, not scientific execution certification. Separate Baseline/Enterprise runs; never pool their QA codes. GOES-16 is a historical archive; an absent end date is not a claim of ongoing acquisition.

identification.identification_note: Version-matched provider metadata; no all-file conformance assessment.

products.description:
M2T3NENAV (or  tavg3_3d_nav_Ne) is a 3-dimensional 3-hourly time-averaged data collection in Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications version 2 (MERRA-2).  This collection consists of vertical coordinates of the 73 model layer edges. The parameters include edge pressure and edge heights.  The data field is available every three hour starting from 01:30 UTC, e.g.: 01:30, 04:30, … , 22:30 UTC. Section 4.2 of the MERRA-2 File Specification document provides pressure values nominal for a 1000 hPa surface pressure and refers to the top edge of the layer. The lev=1 is for the top layer, and lev=73 is for the bottom (or surface) model layer edge.

products.description:
M2T3NVASM (or tavg3_3d_asm_Nv) is a 3-dimensional 3-hourly time averaged data collection in Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications version 2 (MERRA-2).  This collection consists of assimilations of meteorological parameters at 72 model layers, such as air temperature, wind components, vertical pressure velocity, water vapor, and layer height.  The data field is available every three hour starting from  01:30 UTC, e.g.: 01:30, 04:30, … , 22:30 UTC. Section 4.2 of the MERRA-2 File Specification document provides pressure values nominal for a 1000 hPa surface pressure and refers to the top edge of the layer. The lev=1 is for the top layer, and lev=72 is for the bottom (or surface) model layer. 

MERRA-2 is the latest version of global atmospheric reanalysis for the satellite era produced by NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO) using the Goddard Earth Observing System Model (GEOS) version 5.12.4.  The dataset covers the period of 1980-present with the latency of ~3 weeks after the end of a month. 

Data Reprocessing:  Please check “Records of MERRA-2 Data Reprocessing and Service Changes” linked from the “Documentation” tab on this page.  Note that a reprocessed data filename is different from the original file.

products.description: Discovery-only registration of a derived fire-weather product, distinct from native NASA GES DISC MERRA-2. One April 1980 header per cadence verifies CDF-2 classic format, 267 latitude by 576 longitude points and one time value; this is not a full-file or all-years assessment. Provider methods use local-noon meteorology and preceding precipitation; the exact output day boundary and monthly reduction are not established. Spatial support remains other until geometry, datum, valid coverage and cell semantics are reviewed. No variable binding, executable grid, adapter route, or materialized Asset is asserted.

The Collection-006 format-version-03 scope is distinct from the unchanged downloader's unsupported CMR query version 6.1NRT. No exact CMR collection or DOI is invented. Twelve native fields: YYYYMMDD/HHMM are UTC observation coordinates; lat/lon are detection-center coordinates; sat and sample identify sensor/scan position; T21/T31/FRP/conf/type/dn are retained bindings. products.name: narr_psl_daily_surface
products.label: NARR PSL daily surface
products.description: Native PSL daily file grouping. Source time coordinate defines the start and a one-day period; means combine native 00–21 UTC samples, while named sum fields retain their native Sum statistic. 349 × 277 Lambert grid: native x/y coordinates give nominal 32463 m spacing, distinct from a rounded 32 km or the example model spacing. CF Lambert parameters are lat_0=50, lon_0=-107, parallels 50/50, false easting 5632642.22547 m, northing 4612545.65137 m. No radius/datum is supplied in these headers; AMADEUS:100005 is an explicit unresolved placeholder, not WGS84 or a registered engine CRS. Grid coordinates and decoded values are known, but geographic transformation awaits verified earth-model metadata. TKE has 15 pressure levels, not the 29 of other pressure fields. Soil moisture has four native depth labels; soil temperature has five including 800 cm. Depth labels are not asserted as layer centres/bounds. Rewritten local fixtures are not native evidence. The NOAA PSL product page describes daily/monthly versus eight-times-daily deliveries. It is not a substitute for this archive’s native header, variable-specific level coordinates or a verified radius/datum; no new CRS or current archive endpoint is inferred from a family-level page. Reference: https://psl.noaa.gov/data/gridded/data.narr.html.

products.description: Native ZIP contains regional CSV partitions. Select county records and disjoint SCC detail before any aggregation; national/state/regional totals must not be combined with component counties. products.description: Pinned Annual NLCD C1V1; select download_nlcd(product="Land Cover", year=YYYY). Archive Annual_NLCD_LndCov_YYYY_CU_C1V1.zip. products.name: tri_basic_2020_verified_chemicals
products.label: TRI Basic 2020: native-verified chemical/mass fields
products.description: Native 2020 North Carolina CSV verifies chemical identities, exact column headers and unit strata. Bindings cover only the chemicals observed in that sample and six separately documented release fields; they are not a complete national chemical register or every Basic column. The national download route accepts US, state and tbl scopes; this profile points to the inspected NC delivery. Preserve TRIFD/FRS, document control, chemical/CAS/category ID, Form type, YEAR, unit, datum and industry. Off-site totals are attributed to reporting facilities, not the off-site destination geometry. Totals overlap their component fields and must not be added together. Non-reporting and Form A blank amounts are not automatically zero. HORIZONTAL DATUM is blank in all sample rows: do not assert a uniform EPSG:4326. Generic CSV is not csv_station_observations, so native_format is unset. process_tri uses 0.453592 kg/lb (slightly truncated), may group facilities by shared coordinates, and regex-selects columns; these are adapter limitations. calculate_tri creates a distance-decay indicator, not an atmospheric dispersion or exposure model. The catalog exact unit_conversion_formula is declarative and is not executed by process_tri. Its grouped outputs are not lossless facility/document records; sums with na.rm=TRUE and pivot filling can turn missing amounts into zeros. Use the existing tri_read_raw helper for source-record review, preserving native identity and missingness; a blank native datum remains unresolved.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Reporting facilities in the inspected North Carolina 2020 file; no continuous coverage
products.native_spatial_resolution_descriptor: Facility-reported point, with row-level horizontal datum

privacy_profiles.name: location_linked_environmental_data_v1
privacy_profiles.description: Public metadata placeholder for environmental source Products and future location-linked use. No source PHI finding, completed disclosure assessment, transformation, or release approval is asserted. Native spatial support, grid and temporal resolution remain on each Product and GridDefinition. No participant coordinates, household identifiers or restricted records belong here.
privacy_profiles.linkage_risk_note: Public environmental information does not automatically constitute PHI. Values, time series, geographic memberships, distances and combinations of datasets may constrain individual or household locations when linked to precise residences or auxiliary information. Assess the actual joint output, audience and threat model; native cell size and masking alone do not establish privacy or de-identification. Classification of source data does not classify a location-linked derivative.
